# Catalog

<!-- Generated by `make docs` (go run ./catalog/gendoc) from catalog/index.json. Do not edit. -->

25 starter templates are embedded in the binary. Each has a fixture
(catalog/fixtures/) and a golden output (testdata/golden/catalog/) that
`go test ./internal/forge -run CatalogGolden` checks on every build.
Load one with `c NAME` in `tmplforge sh`, open it from the GUI's front
page, or print it with `tmplforge catalog -src NAME`.

Entries with `[[,]]` delimiters produce files that contain `{{ }}` of their own
(GitHub Actions `${{ }}`, Prometheus `{{ $labels }}`, CoreDNS and
consul-template); the alternate delimiters let both coexist.

| Name | Format | Delims | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`CHANGELOG.md`](../catalog/CHANGELOG.md.tmpl) | md | - | Keep-a-Changelog CHANGELOG from a list of releases and typed changes. |
| [`Caddyfile`](../catalog/Caddyfile.tmpl) | txt | - | Caddy v2 Caddyfile: one block per site with optional file server and reverse proxies. |
| [`Corefile`](../catalog/Corefile.tmpl) | txt | `[[,]]` | CoreDNS Corefile with a template plugin block; [[ ]] delimiters leave CoreDNS's own {{ }} alone. |
| [`Dockerfile`](../catalog/Dockerfile.tmpl) | txt | - | Two-stage Go Dockerfile: golang builder to scratch, non-root, labels. |
| [`Makefile`](../catalog/Makefile.tmpl) | txt | - | POSIX make Makefile with a cross-compile target per GOOS/GOARCH (tabs preserved). |
| [`README.md`](../catalog/README.md.tmpl) | md | - | Project README with badges, install steps and a generated command table. |
| [`config.json`](../catalog/config.json.tmpl) | json | - | Application JSON config assembled with dict/list and printed with toPrettyJSON. |
| [`config.yml`](../catalog/config.yml.tmpl) | yaml | - | YAML config: hand-written header, then toYAML of a nested fixture section. |
| [`dispatch.yml`](../catalog/dispatch.yml.tmpl) | yaml | `[[,]]` | workflow_dispatch workflow with typed inputs passed through env, never run interpolation. |
| [`email.html`](../catalog/email.html.tmpl) | html | - | HTML email rendered with html/template: hostile fixture strings are escaped. |
| [`email.txt`](../catalog/email.txt.tmpl) | txt | - | Plain-text email twin of email.html, wrapped at 72 columns. |
| [`hello.c`](../catalog/hello.c.tmpl) | txt | - | Plan 9 C program (u.h, libc.h, ARGBEGIN) printing a configurable greeting. |
| [`hello.go`](../catalog/hello.go.tmpl) | txt | - | Go command with flag package and single-dash flags; output is gofmt-clean. |
| [`htmx-partial.html`](../catalog/htmx-partial.html.tmpl) | html | - | htmx partial: rows that swap themselves, escaped by html/template. |
| [`issue-form.yml`](../catalog/issue-form.yml.tmpl) | yaml | - | GitHub issue form (ISSUE_TEMPLATE) with typed fields and dropdowns. |
| [`job.nomad.hcl`](../catalog/job.nomad.hcl.tmpl) | txt | `[[,]]` | Nomad service job; [[ ]] delimiters keep consul-template {{ }} blocks intact. |
| [`main.tf`](../catalog/main.tf.tmpl) | txt | - | Terraform (integrations/github ~> 6.13): repositories with topics and a branch ruleset. |
| [`mkfile`](../catalog/mkfile.tmpl) | txt | - | Plan 9 mkfile for a C program (mkone), the native build of the Thompson-Pike world. |
| [`motd.txt`](../catalog/motd.txt.tmpl) | txt | - | Message of the day with aligned columns, indent and plural. |
| [`prometheus-rules.yml`](../catalog/prometheus-rules.yml.tmpl) | yaml | `[[,]]` | Prometheus alerting rules; [[ ]] delimiters preserve {{ $labels }} annotations. |
| [`release.yml`](../catalog/release.yml.tmpl) | yaml | `[[,]]` | Tag-triggered release workflow: static binaries, SHA256SUMS, gh release create. |
| [`repository-dispatch.yml`](../catalog/repository-dispatch.yml.tmpl) | yaml | `[[,]]` | repository_dispatch receiver; client_payload flows through env only. |
| [`sparkline.svg`](../catalog/sparkline.svg.tmpl) | html | - | Inline SVG sparkline computed in-template from a list of points. |
| [`sql-migration.sql`](../catalog/sql-migration.sql.tmpl) | txt | - | SQL migration (up/down) from a table spec, with index creation. |
| [`workflow.yml`](../catalog/workflow.yml.tmpl) | yaml | `[[,]]` | GitHub Actions CI workflow: Go matrix build with pinned action majors. |
